oneLiner: Open hackathon judging: every entry gets a rule-by-rule verdict anyone can verify.
description: Eligibility Judge qualifies public GitHub entries against a frozen, validator-accepted rulebook. GenLayer validators independently fetch evidence at the submitted commit, judge one rule per transaction, and verify the exact quote and file path. Entries passing every rule qualify; there are no scores or rankings. Final entries settle after close. Unfinished entries become insufficient evidence after a one-hour grace period and never qualify. Contract code splits a StudioNet GEN pool equally, refunds any remainder or empty qualifying pool, and supports pull claims. Builders get one revision before close; optional demos use dated raw Wayback replays. The mobile app separates recorded proof from finalized live reads, resumes transaction polling across reloads, and supports native appeals. The repository includes tests, source, a tutorial, and a read-only proof verifier. Finalized demo and timeout-refund receipts are recorded in deploy/proof.json.

howTo.heading: Audit the public ledger
howTo.instruction: Open the site without a wallet. Inspect Entries and the frozen Rulebook. Click a rule chip to see its quote and exact file at the commit.

howTo.heading: Read finalized state
howTo.instruction: Choose Live chain. Inspect the labeled read time and contract link. Accepted transactions remain provisional until finality.

howTo.heading: Inspect settlement
howTo.instruction: Choose Payouts and follow settlement, claim and credited-transfer links. Run npm run verify:proof from the public repo.

howTo.heading: Run a new challenge
howTo.instruction: Connect a StudioNet wallet, create and fund a challenge, validate each rule, and submit a public GitHub commit before close. Judge rules before the grace deadline. Settle at close if all entries are final, or one hour after close otherwise; then claim.

expectedOutcome: The standard demo shows one qualified entry, two disqualified fixture commits, and a missing commit with insufficient evidence. All sixteen judgments finalized; equal settlement paid exactly one wei to the qualifier. A separate never-judged entry became insufficient evidence after the real one-hour grace deadline, and its one-wei organizer refund was claimed and credited. The read-only verifier passed all 62 receipts, exact finalized states, deployed source and zero remaining pool. Consult docs/browser-verification.json for production verification status.
